brainlife.desc: FSL BedpostX output directory: ball-and-stick fibre orientation and volume-fraction samples per voxel for probabilistic tractography.
brainlife.name: neuro/FSLBedpostX

original.desc: This datatype is specific to FSL's Bedpost. It contains the entire folder with the results of Bedpost

file_descs.bedpostx: This is a the top-folder generated as output of BedpostX

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Input to FSL probtrackx2 probabilistic tractography.

**Not for:** MRtrix or DIPY tracking Apps; they need FODs or peaks.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.FSLBedpostX.json

files.desc: BedpostX output folder (merged samples, mean maps, mask).

identifying_risks: NIfTI headers or metadata may carry subject codes or dates
Rare lesions or anomalies can be recognisable in small samples
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed diffusion MRI without direct identifiers.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Check headers and metadata for identifiers before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only as a group-averaged template
Tier 4 if used as features for predicting cognitive or clinical states

intended_use: Input to FSL probtrackx2 probabilistic tractography.
not_suitable_for: MRtrix or DIPY tracking Apps; they need FODs or peaks.
